wizard.title: Bulk Upload Plots

download.title: Step 1: Download the template
download.description: Download the Excel template, fill in one row per plot, and upload it back here. Dropdowns for status, facing and size unit help avoid typos.

upload.title: Step 2: Upload your filled-in file
upload.description: Choose the Excel file you filled in.
upload.dropHint: Drag and drop your file here, or click to choose
upload.duplicateMode: If a plot number already exists
upload.autoPlace: Automatically place plots on the grid using row/column columns

preview.title: Step 3: Preview and fix errors
preview.summary: {{valid}} valid, {{invalid}} need fixing, of {{total}} total rows

commit.title: Step 4: Commit the import
commit.description: This will create plots from every valid row. Rows with errors will be skipped unless you fix them first.
commit.skipInvalid: Import valid rows and skip the ones with errors

wizard.cancelConfirm: Cancel this import? Nothing will be created.
